entities.name: Kal
entities.description: A young Gruul shaman of the Zhur-Taa clan, sent to spy on the Izzet, who invents a new fire-and-lightning spell from what he learned watching them.

entities.name: Nikya of the Old Ways
entities.description: Leader of the Zhur-Taa clan of the Gruul, who calls bloodcrime on the Rakdos and leads a war-party against them.

entities.name: Durri
entities.description: A young Zhur-Taa scout and Kal's friend.

entities.name: Janik
entities.description: A Zhur-Taa warrior who catches Kal following the war-party.

entities.name: Ogreth
entities.description: A Gruul who reported that the Rakdos were responsible for the massacre.

entities.name: Massacre Girl
aliases: the one they call Massacre Girl
entities.description: A Rakdos leader, 'the monster' of the war-party's hunt, who escapes the battle without a corpse being found.

entities.name: Zhur-Taa
entities.description: A Gruul clan of the Rubblebelt led by Nikya.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: The shamanic, hunter clans of Ravnica who claim the lawless zones.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of chemisters and guildmages whose chaotic spellcasting Kal studies.

entities.name: Cult of Rakdos
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of thrill-killers and murder-gangs whose band massacres the Selesnyan camp.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose healer's camp in the Rubblebelt was massacred.

entities.name: Rubblebelt
entities.description: A ruined, lawless region of Ravnica claimed by the Gruul.

entities.name: Speaking Mound
entities.description: A mound of stone blocks where Nikya addresses her clan.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city plane where the story takes place.

events.summary: Kal watches the Izzet from an abandoned Orzhov spire, sent by his clan leader to make sure they do not encroach on Zhur-Taa territory.
events.quote: Kal was sent to watch the Izzet by his clan leader, Nikya of the Old Ways

events.summary: Durri tells Kal that the Selesnyan healer's camp was massacred, reportedly by the Rakdos.
events.quote: Ogreth said it was the Rakdos.

events.summary: Nikya gathers the Zhur-Taa at the Speaking Mound and declares the right to claim bloodcrime on the Rakdos.
events.quote: we have the right to claim bloodcrime and seek vengeance from the Rakdos

events.summary: Nikya picks her war-party; she does not touch Kal's weapon.
events.quote: her hand never touched his outstretched weapon

events.summary: Kal secretly tracks the war-party on foot to protect Durri.
events.quote: Kal tracked the war party from a distance.

events.summary: Janik catches Kal and nearly skewers him before the battle begins.
events.quote: A warrior named Janik hissed at Kal.

events.summary: Nikya entangles a Rakdos ogre in vines as the Zhur-Taa fight the Rakdos swarm.
events.quote: A huge wall of vines entangled a massive Rakdos ogre

events.summary: A Rakdos bloodwitch summons batlike demons from the earth, and the tide turns against the Gruul.
events.quote: massive, wet claws erupted from the earth

events.summary: A Rakdos flailer hooks Kal and drags him across the ground.
Kal channels what he learned from the Izzet into a fire-and-lightning spell that incinerates the flailer, the demons and the remaining Rakdos.
events.quote: A blast of fire incinerated the grinning flailer.

events.summary: Nikya reveals that Massacre Girl escaped, but Kal killed a bloodwitch.
events.quote: Nikya held up the bloodwitch's charred head.

events.summary: Kal credits his new spell to watching the Izzet; Durri calls it Gruul.
events.quote: I think I learned it from watching the Izzet.

relations.note: Nikya is the clan leader of the Zhur-Taa.
relations.quote: his clan leader, Nikya of the Old Ways
Just because Kal was born to the Gruul

relations.note: Durri is a young scout of the clan.
relations.quote: Durri, a young scout from the Zhur-Taa

relations.note: Kal follows the war-party to protect his friend.
relations.quote: He could not abandon his friend.

relations.note: The Rakdos have caused the Gruul much pain in the Rubblebelt.
relations.quote: Much pain had been caused by the Rakdos out in the Rubblebelt
all Gruul were raised as hunters
